mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in GDP growth rate signals a robust demand environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong GDP growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate below 0.2% signals an extremely accommodative monetary policy, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when the federal funds rate is below 0.2% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in payroll employment and a decline in the unemployment rate signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong labor market growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production growth rate below -0.5% signals a supply chain disruption, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when the industrial production growth rate is below -0.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in housing starts signals a robust demand environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong housing starts growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in the federal funds rate and a decline in the consumer price index signals a monetary policy tightening cycle, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of monetary policy tightening (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate above 5.5% signals a weak labor market, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when the unemployment rate is above 5.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in retail sales and a decline in the personal savings rate signals a strong consumer demand environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong consumer demand growth (t-test p > 0.05).
